cards.ex: The company had to lay off staff to balance the books after a bad year.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yomon yildan so'ng hisobni to'g'rilash uchun xodimlarni qisqartirishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kirim va chiqimni tenglashtirish, moliyaviy holatni tartibga solish.

cards.ex: It's hard to make ends meet when you're only earning minimum wage.
cards.exUz: Eng kam ish haqi bilan ro'zg'orni tebratish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Daromad bilan xarajatni qoplash, pulni yetkazish.

cards.ex: We'll have to tighten our belts if we want to save up for a house.
cards.exUz: Agar uy uchun pul yig'moqchi bo'lsak, kamarni mahkam bog'lashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The business has been in the red for the last two quarters.
cards.exUz: Biznes oxirgi ikki chorakda qarzdorlikda bo'ldi.

cards.ex: After a successful marketing campaign, the company is finally in the black.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatli marketing kampaniyasidan so'ng, kompaniya nihoyat foydaga kirdi.

cards.ex: Don't worry, buying a used car won't break the bank.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olmang, ishlatilgan mashina sotib olish bankrot qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qimmatga tushmoq, katta xarajat qilmoq.

cards.ex: My parents footed the bill for my college education.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam mening kollej ta'limim uchun to'lovni qopladilar.

cards.ex: That software is our cash cow; it generates the most revenue.
cards.exUz: Bu dasturiy ta'minot bizning doimiy daromadimiz; u eng ko'p daromad keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy daromad keltiruvchi narsa yoki biznes.

cards.ex: She's been building a nest egg for her retirement.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqishi uchun jamg'arma yig'moqda.

cards.ex: It's always a good idea to have a rainy day fund.
cards.exUz: Har doim qora kun uchun jamg'arma bo'lishi yaxshi fikr.

cards.ex: He thought he could make easy money trading stocks, but he lost everything.
cards.exUz: U aksiyalarni sotish orqali oson pul topaman deb o'yladi, lekin hamma narsani yo'qotdi.

cards.ex: Remember, money doesn't grow on trees, so spend wisely.
cards.exUz: Unutmang, pul daraxtda o'smaydi, shuning uchun oqilona sarflang.
cards.uzDef: Pul osonlikcha topilmaydi, uni qadrlash kerak.

cards.ex: They were traveling on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Ular juda kam pul bilan sayohat qilishayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan, tejamkorlik bilan.

cards.ex: I had to shell out a lot of money to get my car repaired.
cards.exUz: Mashinamni tuzatish uchun ko'p pul sarflashimga to'g'ri keldi.

cards.ex: It's time to pony up and pay your share of the bill.
cards.exUz: To'lovning o'z ulushingizni to'lash vaqti keldi.

cards.ex: That painting must have cost a pretty penny.
cards.exUz: Bu rasm qimmatga tushgan bo'lsa kerak.

cards.ex: The landlord is always nickel and diming us for small repairs.
cards.exUz: Uy egasi bizni har doim kichik ta'mirlashlar uchun mayda xarajatlar bilan bezovta qiladi.

cards.ex: Many families are living paycheck to paycheck these days.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oilalar hozirda oylikdan oylikka yashamoqda.

cards.ex: The CEO was arrested for cooking the books.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor hisobotlarni soxtalashtirgani uchun hibsga olindi.

cards.ex: Let's go Dutch on dinner tonight.
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun kechki ovqatga har kim o'zi to'laydi.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishi o'z hissasini to'lashi.

cards.ex: Be careful dealing with loan sharks; they can be dangerous.
cards.exUz: Sudxo'rlar bilan ishlashda ehtiyot bo'ling; ular xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Juda yuqori foiz evaziga pul beruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: The government had to bail out the failing bank.
cards.exUz: Hukumat qulayotgan bankga yordam berishga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The company had to write off a bad debt.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya umidsiz qarzni hisobdan chiqarishga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I had to fork out a fortune for new tires.
cards.exUz: Men yangi g'ildiraklar uchun katta pul ajratishimga to'g'ri keldi.

cards.ex: He hit the jackpot when he sold his company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyasini sotganda omadi chopdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdorda pul yutish yoki topish.

cards.ex: Many businesses went bust during the recession.
cards.exUz: Recessiya davrida ko'plab korxonalar bankrot bo'ldi.

cards.ex: He was caught skimming off profits from the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaning foydasidan yashirincha pul o'g'irlaganda qo'lga tushdi.

cards.ex: A fool and his money are soon parted.
cards.exUz: Aqmoq puli tezda yo'qoladi.

cards.ex: They used their nest-egg to buy a small cottage by the sea.
cards.exUz: Ular jamg'armalaridan dengiz bo'yida kichik kottej sotib olish uchun foydalanishdi.

cards.ex: The company cashed in on the latest trend.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya so'nggi trenddan foydalandi.
